integrity: The claim is proved analytically from the printed scaled equations. Source equations, coexistence equilibrium, and the reported bistable cycles were independently checked in the public full text. No numerical trajectory data are used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Periodic-orbit theorem only; it does not prove cycle existence, stability, period, or nonperiodic statistical limits. The variance comparison is in the nondimensional variables used by the source.
title: Finite-amplitude mean–variance shell for delayed predator–prey cycles
